```{r, engine='tikz'}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta, positioning, shapes.geometric, fit, calc, backgrounds}

% ---------- Styles (lecture-friendly) ----------
\tikzset{
  phase/.style   = {rounded corners, draw, thick, fill=blue!15,
                    minimum width=2.8cm, minimum height=1.2cm,
                    align=center, font=\bfseries\large},
  inner/.style   = {rounded corners, draw, thick, fill=green!15,
                    minimum width=2.6cm, minimum height=1.0cm,
                    align=center, font=\bfseries\large},
  link/.style    = {thick, -{Stealth[length=3mm,width=2mm]}},
  boxlab/.style  = {font=\bfseries\large, fill=white, inner sep=1pt}
}

\begin{tikzpicture}[x=1cm,y=1cm]

% ---------- Outer linear flow ----------
\node (import) [phase] {Import};
\node (tidy)   [phase, right=2.8cm of import] {Tidy};

% Center for "Understand" inner cycle
\coordinate (ucenter) at ($(tidy.east)+(4.8cm,0)$);
\def\R{1.6}

% Inner cycle nodes (equilateral triangle)
\path (ucenter)+(90:\R)   coordinate (ctrans);
\path (ucenter)+(-30:\R)  coordinate (cvis);
\path (ucenter)+(210:\R)  coordinate (cmod);

\node (transform) [inner] at (ctrans) {Transform};
\node (visualize) [inner] at (cvis)   {Visualize};
\node (model)     [inner] at (cmod)   {Model};

% ---------- Understand background (behind inner nodes) ----------
\begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
  \node (understand) [draw, thick, rounded corners=6pt, fill=gray!10, inner sep=10mm,
                      fit=(transform)(visualize)(model)] {};
\end{pgfonlayer}

% Label for "Understand" (on top)
\node[boxlab] at ($(understand.north west)+(0.35,0.25)$) {Understand};

% Communicate
\node (communicate) [phase, right=2.8cm of understand.east] {Communicate};

% ---------- Outer arrows (cycle) ----------
\draw[link] (import) -- (tidy);
\draw[link] (tidy.east) -- ($(understand.west)+(0,0)$);
\draw[link] (understand.east) -- (communicate.west);

% Return arrow to make the full cycle
\draw[link] (communicate.south) to[out=-30, in=-150, looseness=1.1] (import.south);

% ---------- Inner cycle arrows ----------
\draw[link] (transform) -- (visualize);
\draw[link] (visualize) -- (model);
\draw[link] (model) -- (transform);

% ---------- "Program" wrapper (behind everything) ----------
\begin{pgfonlayer}{background}
  \node (programwrap) [draw, very thick, rounded corners=10pt, dashed,
                       inner sep=12mm, fit=(import)(tidy)(understand)(communicate)] {};
\end{pgfonlayer}
% Label for Program
\node[boxlab] at ($(programwrap.north east)+(-0.2,0.2)$) {Program};

\end{tikzpicture}
```
